comments.author: BIakeC
comments.body: It seems they nerfed the amount of credits you get when doing research with this skill. You now only get 1,500 credits instead of 3,500. Im guessing it's because it would make grinding credits too easy with the new bulk production feature, and the mayor system which allows you get to get more credits if you report at a non-territory port with a active mayor.

comments.author: Will_Adams
comments.body: Bulk production has reduced the time needed to complete this thesis by about 35%, wheras the number of credits achieved for completing this thesis has been reduced by almost 60%, meaning it now takes about twice as long as it used to to obtain max(50k) credits doing this thesis as it did before bulk production was introduced. I'd say a more realistic number of credits to give for this thesis is 2500 at least, that's about a 35-40% reduction which is more of a balance in regards to time needed to complete it.

comments.author: Guilder
comments.body:
This nerf, while unfortunate, is consistent with Japan's "ahead of us by a year" model. I'd love to see 2,500 credits, or even the old 3,500. Judging by how their pay-for servers have decided to go about doing things, though, it'll likely be 1,500 from now on.

Source: gvo.gamedb.info/wiki/?University
